evidence_note: This register identifies reproduction targets and source snapshots. It does not claim reproduction, performance superiority, or platform-independent guarantees.

publications.title: Comparison of state-of-the-art error-correction coding for sequence-based DNA data storage
publications.interpretation: Separate in-silico feasibility from the two different in-vitro synthesis demonstrations. The study's maximum isolated error/sequence-loss tolerance scenarios are not universal physical channel guarantees.

publications.title: Polus: a context-aware enhancement framework for DNA storage via transformer-based soft-decision decoding
publications.enhancement: SeqFormer consensus and calibrated per-base confidence; low-confidence positions become progressive candidate erasures after hard-decision/CRC failure.
publications.platform_scope: Illumina-like and ONT-like in-silico error profiles; model calibration is platform-specific.
publications.interpretation: All percentage results are paper/setup-specific in-silico results. They are reproduction targets, not in-vitro physical measurements or Luminous Dynamics achievements.
